tours.name: Archive a Salary Rule
tours.description: Learn how to archive a salary rule that should no longer be applied, without losing the payslips that already used it.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to archive a salary rule that should no longer be applied, without losing the payslips that already used it.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Salary rules are managed in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Salary rules are managed in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the master data of the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the master data of the Payroll app.

steps.title: Rules
steps.description: Salary rules calculate the lines of a payslip. An archived rule is skipped on new payslips.

description_i18n.en_US: Salary rules calculate the lines of a payslip. An archived rule is skipped on new payslips.

steps.title: Find the salary rule
steps.content: Type the name of the salary rule and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the salary rule and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you select the right record. Only select a record you no longer need.

steps.title: Open the group
steps.content: Click the group that contains the rule to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the group that contains the rule to open it.

steps.description: Salary rules are grouped by salary structure. Click a group heading to show the rules inside it.

description_i18n.en_US: Salary rules are grouped by salary structure. Click a group heading to show the rules inside it.

steps.title: Select it
steps.content: Tick the box in front of the salary rule.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the box in front of the salary rule.

steps.description: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to archive them together.

description_i18n.en_US: The Actions menu appears as soon as a record is ticked. You can tick several records to archive them together.

steps.title: Actions
steps.description: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

description_i18n.en_US: Everything you can do to the ticked records is in this menu.

steps.title: Archive
steps.description: Archiving hides the record from lists and from the choices in other forms, but keeps all its history. An archived record can be restored later from the Archived filter.

description_i18n.en_US: Archiving hides the record from lists and from the choices in other forms, but keeps all its history. An archived record can be restored later from the Archived filter.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.content: Click Archive in the window to confirm.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Archive in the window to confirm.

steps.description: Check the rule is not needed by any structure before you confirm, because new payslips will no longer include it.

description_i18n.en_US: Check the rule is not needed by any structure before you confirm, because new payslips will no longer include it.
